summary.text: Ira Hansen is a Republican member of the Nevada State Senate who has represented District 14 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served in the Nevada State Assembly from 2010 to 2018.

paragraphs.text: Ira Hansen's professional experience includes founding Ira Hansen and Sons Plumbing and Heating and working as owner and manager of Ira Hansen and Sons Disaster Cleanup; he has also been a talk show host and a columnist at the Sparks Tribune and Elko Daily Free Press.
He represented District 32 in the Nevada State Assembly from 2010 to 2018 and assumed office in the Senate on November 7, 2018.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Senate Growth and Infrastructure, Senate Judiciary, and Senate Natural Resources committees.
